trip.name: Trip.com
trip.note: Most codes are tied to a payment card or region and are first come, first served. Hong Kong amounts are in HK$. Paste the code on the payment page.
trip.note_zh: 大部分優惠碼與付款卡或地區掛鈎，先到先得。香港金額以港幣計。在付款頁貼上優惠碼。

sbc.name: Sicily by Car
sbc.note: No open public promo right now. Every valid code is for a group, and the counter asks for proof at pickup. Without it they charge full price or can refuse the car. You need a credit card in the driver's name. A Black Friday code usually appears in late November.
sbc.note_zh: 現時沒有公開優惠。所有有效優惠碼都屬特定團體，取車時櫃枱會要求證明，否則會收原價或拒絕租車。須有主司機名下的信用卡。黑色星期五優惠碼通常在 11 月下旬推出。

europcar.name: Europcar
europcar.note: Current discounts are built-in offers: book through the offer page, no code to type. The two Italy offers can't be stacked, so compare both for your dates. You need a credit card in the main driver's name.
europcar.note_zh: 現時的折扣都是內置優惠：經優惠頁預訂，不用輸入優惠碼。兩個意大利優惠不能疊加，按你的日期比較兩者。須有主司機名下的信用卡。

klook.name: Klook
klook.note: Hong Kong codes are listed in HK$ and most have a minimum spend and a quota, so popular ones run out early. Many need a specific card or wallet (Mastercard, UnionPay, PayMe, AlipayHK, Octopus). Enter the code on the payment page; one code per order.
klook.note_zh: 香港優惠碼以港幣列出，大多有最低消費及名額，熱門的很快用完。很多須用指定信用卡或電子錢包（Mastercard、銀聯、PayMe、AlipayHK、八達通）。在付款頁輸入優惠碼，每張訂單限用一個。

hotelscom.name: Hotels.com
hotelscom.note: The 8% codes work on the Hong Kong site with a card issued in Hong Kong. One room per booking, and not with "Pay at hotel". Some codes only work through the bank's own Hotels.com link.
hotelscom.note_zh: 92 折優惠碼適用於香港網站及香港發出的信用卡。每次預訂一間房，不適用於「到店付款」。部分優惠碼只能經銀行專屬的 Hotels.com 連結使用。

expedia.name: Expedia
expedia.note: Bank codes work only on the bank's own Expedia Hong Kong page (for example expedia.com.hk/amex), for prepaid hotel-only bookings. Packages and pay-at-hotel rates don't qualify. Type the code in "Enter voucher code" at payment.
expedia.note_zh: 銀行優惠碼只適用於銀行專屬的 Expedia 香港頁面（例如 expedia.com.hk/amex），只限預付純酒店預訂。套票及到店付款不適用。在付款時「輸入優惠碼」一欄輸入。

agoda.name: Agoda
agoda.note: Most Agoda savings are claim-link deals and card pages, not codes. Codes take a percentage off the room rate only (not taxes), and the real saving is often smaller than the headline.
agoda.note_zh: Agoda 的優惠大多是領取連結及信用卡專頁，而非優惠碼。優惠碼只減房價百分比（不包稅項），實際省下的通常比標題少。

booking.name: Booking.com
booking.note: Booking.com almost never uses public promo codes. Sign in to get Genius prices (10–20% off at properties with the blue Genius label) and look for Getaway or Late Escape deals. Codes on coupon sites are usually fake or partner-only.
booking.note_zh: Booking.com 幾乎從不使用公開優惠碼。登入後可享 Genius 價（有藍色 Genius 標籤的住宿 8 至 9 折），並留意 Getaway 或 Late Escape 優惠。優惠網站上的優惠碼通常是假的或只限合作夥伴。

skyscanner.name: Skyscanner
skyscanner.note: Skyscanner is a price comparison site, not a seller, so it has no promo codes. You book on the airline or agent site it sends you to (Trip.com, Opodo, Kiwi.com, the airline). Apply codes for that site instead. The same goes for Kayak and Google Flights.
skyscanner.note_zh: Skyscanner 是比價網站，不是賣家，所以沒有優惠碼。你會在它轉介的航空公司或代理網站預訂（Trip.com、Opodo、Kiwi.com、航空公司），改用該網站的優惠碼。Kayak 及 Google Flights 亦一樣。

kiwi.name: Kiwi.com
kiwi.note: Kiwi.com codes on coupon sites are mostly old. One code per booking. Check the price drops before you pay.
kiwi.note_zh: 優惠網站上的 Kiwi.com 優惠碼大多已舊。每次預訂限用一個。付款前檢查價格有否下降。

opodo.name: Opodo / eDreams
opodo.note: Opodo and eDreams push their paid Prime membership for discounts. Coupon-site codes hide the code text and many are old Black Friday codes. App-only offers come and go.
opodo.note_zh: Opodo 及 eDreams 主力推銷付費 Prime 會員折扣。優惠網站隱藏優惠碼文字，很多是舊的黑色星期五優惠碼。App 專屬優惠時有時無。

avis.name: Avis
avis.note: Avis uses AWD numbers (company or club rates) and coupon codes. Public savings come from the free Avis Preferred programme and offers on the Avis deals page. Only use an AWD number you're entitled to; the counter can check.
avis.note_zh: Avis 使用 AWD 編號（公司或會所價）及優惠券碼。公開優惠來自免費的 Avis Preferred 計劃及 Avis 優惠頁。只使用你有資格的 AWD 編號，櫃枱可以查核。

hertz.name: Hertz
hertz.note: Hertz discounts use a CDP code (from an employer, club or card) plus an optional PC promotional code. Using a CDP you're not entitled to can get the rental repriced at the counter.
hertz.note_zh: Hertz 折扣使用 CDP 碼（來自僱主、會所或信用卡）加可選的 PC 推廣碼。使用不合資格的 CDP，櫃枱可能重新計價。

sixt.name: Sixt
sixt.note: Sixt has few public rental codes. Most shared codes are for its chauffeur and ride service. Check the Sixt offers page for your country.
sixt.note_zh: Sixt 公開租車優惠碼很少。大部分流傳的優惠碼是專車服務用的。查看你所在國家的 Sixt 優惠頁。

rentalcars.name: Rentalcars.com
rentalcars.note: Rentalcars.com rarely accepts codes. Coupon-site codes were last seen working in 2022. Card and airline partner links are the reliable way to get a discount.
rentalcars.note_zh: Rentalcars.com 很少接受優惠碼。優惠網站的優惠碼最後一次有效是 2022 年。信用卡及航空公司合作連結才是可靠的折扣途徑。

discovercars.name: Discover Cars
discovercars.note: One code per booking, not combined with other promotions, and usually not on prepaid partner packages from Hertz or Europcar.
discovercars.note_zh: 每次預訂限用一個優惠碼，不可與其他推廣同用，通常不適用於 Hertz 或 Europcar 的預付套票。

iherb.name: iHerb
iherb.note: One code per order. HK codes need a Hong Kong delivery address and often an account limit. Codes take money off the product total, not shipping.
iherb.note_zh: 每張訂單限用一個優惠碼。香港優惠碼須用香港送貨地址，通常有帳戶限制。優惠碼只減貨品總額，不減運費。

hktvmall.name: HKTVmall
hktvmall.note: Most codes are for specific categories (beauty, baby, appliances) and only count spend on those items. VIP members get 5% on Wednesdays and Citi HKTVmall cardholders 5% on Thursdays, with codes shown in the app.
hktvmall.note_zh: 大部分優惠碼只適用於指定類別（美容、嬰兒、電器），只計算該類貨品的消費。VIP 會員逢星期三 95 折，Citi HKTVmall 信用卡逢星期四 95 折，優惠碼在 App 內顯示。

taobao.name: Taobao
taobao.note: Codes are in RMB (¥) and first come, first served, especially during Double 11 (20 Oct to 13 Nov 2026). Payment method matters: AlipayHK and PayMe have their own codes, and a normal HK credit card adds about 5% in fees.
taobao.note_zh: 優惠碼以人民幣（¥）計，先到先得，雙 11 期間（2026 年 10 月 20 日至 11 月 13 日）尤其如此。付款方式有影響：AlipayHK 及 PayMe 有各自的優惠碼，一般香港信用卡會多收約 5% 手續費。

zalora.name: Zalora
zalora.note: One code per order. Free delivery from HK$299. New members get a first-order discount after signing up to the newsletter.
zalora.note_zh: 每張訂單限用一個優惠碼。滿 HK$299 免運費。新會員訂閱電子報後可享首單折扣。

dyson.name: Dyson
dyson.note: Codes work on selected products only on the Dyson Hong Kong online store.
dyson.note_zh: 優惠碼只適用於 Dyson 香港網店的指定產品。

watsons.name: Watsons
watsons.note: Watsons online codes are often free gifts with a minimum spend, not money off.
watsons.note_zh: 屈臣氏網店優惠碼通常是滿額送禮品，不是減價。

pns.name: PARKnSHOP
pns.note: Online store codes. Some only work with click & collect.
pns.note_zh: 網店優惠碼。部分只適用於店舖自取。

charleskeith.name: Charles & Keith
charleskeith.note: First-purchase code on the Hong Kong online store.
charleskeith.note_zh: 香港網店首次購物優惠碼。

crocs.name: Crocs
crocs.note: New member code on the Hong Kong online store.
crocs.note_zh: 香港網店新會員優惠碼。

foodpanda.name: foodpanda
foodpanda.note: Enter the code at checkout in the app. New-user codes work on your first order only. Card and wallet codes have a limited quota each month. pandapro members get free delivery from HK$120 at many restaurants.
foodpanda.note_zh: 在 App 結帳時輸入優惠碼。新用戶優惠碼只適用於首單。信用卡及電子錢包優惠碼每月限量。pandapro 會員在很多餐廳滿 HK$120 免運費。

keeta.name: Keeta
keeta.note: Codes are tied to the payment method (AlipayHK, PayMe) and run until the quota runs out. New users get bigger first-order discounts automatically in the app.
keeta.note_zh: 優惠碼與付款方式掛鈎（AlipayHK、PayMe），額滿即止。新用戶在 App 內自動獲得更大的首單折扣。

airalo.name: Airalo
airalo.note: Travel eSIM. One code per purchase; new-account codes only work on a fresh account.
airalo.note_zh: 旅遊 eSIM。每次購買限用一個優惠碼；新帳戶優惠碼只適用於全新帳戶。

trainline.name: Trainline
trainline.note: Trainline rarely has public codes. The referral discount attaches to your email, so there is no code to type.
trainline.note_zh: Trainline 很少有公開優惠碼。推薦折扣綁定你的電郵，不用輸入優惠碼。

moretickets.note: Concert and show tickets for Hong Kong and Macau.
